title: Nucleus Pulse v0.35 preregistration

config.feature_definition: 16 equal temporal bins, 2 ticks per bin, hidden spike counts divided by 2

shared_base_recurrent_matrix.source: v0.34 Dale-style 25% inhibitory matrix, generated once per reservoir seed

config.baseline: Dale-style 25% inhibitory sources with fixed inhibitory gain = 1.0

treatment.name: global activity-dependent inhibitory gain
treatment.rule: gain_t = clip(1 + slope * (ema_population_rate_t - target_rate), min_gain, max_gain)
treatment.activity_trace_initialization: target_rate, producing initial gain 1.0 before observed activity
treatment.parameter_source: predefined from v0.34 activity diagnostic; no v0.35 validation/test tuning

notes: Final-test data are never used for tuning or selection.
All conditions use the same underlying Dale recurrent matrix within each seed.
Activity-dependent gain parameters were fixed before this version official run.
The implementation audit clarified that the initial gain is computed from the initialized EMA before the first observed spike; the corrected official run starts gain at exactly 1.0.
